title: Get Started
text: default, comparisons = NULL auto-generates pairwise one--comparisons factor levels var. can instead pass character vector specific comparisons run.

title: Get Started
text: Comparisons follow format "numerator_vs_denominator". positive log2FoldChange means gene upregulated numerator group relative denominator group.
code: # Run only selected pairwise comparisons dds <- run_rna_pip(     dds,     org = "mouse",     var = "Group2",     design = "~ Group3 + Group2",     comparisons = c("IgA_vs_IgM", "IgG_vs_IgM"),     save_dir = save_dir)

title: Get Started
text: Use + pool multiple groups one side comparison:
code: # IgA and IgG pooled vs IgM dds <- run_rna_pip(     dds,     org = "mouse",     var = "Group2",     design = "~ Group3 + Group2",     comparisons = c("IgA+IgG_vs_IgM"),     save_dir = save_dir)

title: RNA-seq Analysis Guide
text: Let’s import prepare data. ’ll use example dataset GSE189410 demonstrate workflow:
code: # load example DESeq2 object rdata <- system.file("data", "GSE189410.dds.RData", package = "deseq2pip") tx2gene <- gzfile(system.file("data", "GSE189410.tx2gene.tsv.gz", package = "deseq2pip")) dds <- import_nfcore_rna(rdata = rdata, tx2gene = tx2gene)  # set group variable (optional to manually set reference level) dds$Group2 <- factor(dds$Group2, c('IgM', 'IgG', 'IgA')) dds$Group3 <- factor(dds$Group3, c(1:4))  # set dds design with desired variables # for more information about setting design matrix in DESeq2, see: https://github.com/tavareshugo/tutorial_DESeq2_contrasts?tab=readme-ov-file design(dds) <- ~ Group3 + Group2

title: RNA-seq Analysis Guide
text: run_deseq2_pip() function wrapper function runs complete RNA-seq analysis every PAIRWISE ONE--comparison pairs specified group variable. analysis comparison pair can broken three modules: Quality Control: Filters genes, generates QC/PCA/distance plots, saves expression data run_qc_pip() run_dist_pip() Differential Expression Analysis: Performs DESeq2 analysis, functional gene annotation, creates volcano plots run_diffexp_pip() plot_peak_annot_pip() (ATAC-seq ) GSEA Analysis: Find enriched pathways using MSigDB collections prepare results EnrichmentMap visualization run_gsea_pip() run_enrichmentmap_pip() example dataset, 3 comparison pairs group variable Group2: IgM vs IgG, IgM vs IgA, IgG vs IgA. ’s run complete pipeline single command: Note: Repeating run_deseq2_pip overwrite existing files directory name used. prevent , please specify different save_dir directory. First, set global arguments.
code: # set pipeline arguments var <- "Group2" # required org <- "mouse" # required design <- "~ Group3 + Group2" # required comparisons <- c("IgG_vs_IgM", "IgA_vs_IgM", "IgA_vs_IgG", "IgM_vs_IgA+IgG", "IgG_vs_IgA+IgM", "IgA_vs_IgG+IgM") # optional batch <- "Group3" # optional remove_xy <- FALSE # optional remove_mt <- FALSE # optional min_count <- 10 # optional pals <- NULL # optional order <- "pxfc" # optional save_dir <- tempdir() dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE) # run deseq2 pipeline run_rna_pip(dds = dds, org = org, var = var, design = design, batch = batch, comparisons = comparisons, remove_xy = remove_xy, remove_mt = remove_mt, min_count = min_count, pals = pals, order = order, save_dir = save_dir)

title: RNA-seq Analysis Guide
text: initial run DESeq2 pipeline, may wish run specific module using different parameters comparison groups without repeating entire pipeline. ’s run module separately. commands run individual module:
code: save_dir <- tempdir() dir.create(save_dir, recursive = TRUE) # Module 1: Quality Control dds <- run_qc_pip(dds = dds, org = org, var = var, remove_xy = remove_xy, remove_mt = remove_mt, min_count = min_count, save_dir = save_dir) dds <- run_dist_pip(dds = dds, var = var, batch = batch, pals = pals, save_dir = save_dir) # Module 2: Differential Expression Analysis res <- run_diffexp_pip(dds, org = org, var = var, design = design, comparisons = NULL, order = order, save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/", var)) # Module 3: GSEA Analysis gsea <- run_gsea_pip(res = res, org = org, save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/", var)) # Module 4: EnrichmentMap enrichmentmap_pip(dds, org = org, var = var, group_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/", var), save_dir = paste0(save_dir, "/", var))
